visual_style: tiny cute stylized 3D animation, miniature proportions, cinematic but readable, warm educational tone, physically believable ship machinery
audience: Engine Cadet candidates preparing for maritime interviews
story_rule: Every episode starts from one interview question and teaches the answer through a small engine-room story.
teaching_rule: Technical accuracy has priority over comedy. Never invent machinery behavior to create drama.
continuity_rules: Recurring characters keep the same face, body proportions, clothing, helmet and voice identity across episodes.
The engine-room visual language stays consistent across episodes.
Every scene must serve either story progression or technical explanation.
The final 10-15 seconds must surface the interview question and a concise model answer.

audio_direction.music: playful cinematic miniature adventure, light percussion, subtle industrial texture, warm educational mood, instrumental only
audio_direction.ambience: merchant ship engine-room room tone, low machinery hum, ventilation and metal resonance when visually appropriate
audio_direction.mix_priority: dialogue > important synchronized SFX > ambience > music
